nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of contract owner, controls access to admin functions
Ownable(): sets owner = msg.sender at deployment
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that replaces owner
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for authorization and payment routing
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access control gate
isVariation: public flag marking this contract as a variation contract
randomSeed: pseudo-random seed accumulated across calls (overflow prone)
lottery: LotteryInterface contract reference used for prize pool queries
dogCore: DogCoreInterface contract reference used for dog data and payouts
cVariations: dynamic array of CVariation rounds holding lucky dogs, accounts, amount and withdrawBlock
variationProbably: probability factor (1..100) used in variation random check
variationCycle: number of blocks between variation rounds (<=172800)
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value feeding keccak256 randomness
random(): internal pseudo-random generator using block.timestamp, block.difficulty, block.number and randomSeed
keccak256(block.timestamp, randomSeed * block.difficulty): timestamp/difficulty derived randomness
randomValue: keccak256 result inside random()
randomSeed = uint256(randomValue * block.number): unchecked multiplication updating the seed
setVariationProbably(uint256): onlyOwner setter for variationProbably with 1..100 bounds
_value parameter of setVariationProbably
setVariationCycle(uint256): onlyOwner setter for variationCycle with 1..172800 bounds
_value parameter of setVariationCycle
Variation(address,address): constructor wiring dogCore, lottery and initial CVariation round
_dogCore parameter of the Variation constructor
_lottery parameter of the Variation constructor
setLotteryAddress(address): onlyOwner function validating candidate via isLottery() and storing lottery
_lottery parameter of setLotteryAddress
createVariation(uint256,uint256): privileged random outcome generator mixing _gene into randomSeed
_gene parameter of createVariation
_totalSupply parameter of createVariation
randomSeed = uint256(randomSeed * _gene): unchecked multiplication of seed (overflow)
variationRandom: output of random() in createVariation
totalRandom: _totalSupply or 20000 floor in createVariation
variationRandom % uint256(totalRandom * variationProbably): unchecked multiplication inside modulus
registerVariation(uint256,address): privileged push of dogId/owner into the current round
_dogId parameter of registerVariation
_owner parameter of registerVariation
callBackVariations(): settles the current round and distributes rewards via external calls
index: loop counter in callBackVariations
luckyAmount: prize pool share computed from dogCore balance minus spool
(dogCore.getAvailableBlance() - spoolAmount) * 3 / 100: unchecked arithmetic on external balance reading
luckySize: number of winners, mutated during settlement
reward: per-winner payout amount
currentCVariation.totalAmount * 9 / (10 * luckySize): unchecked multiplication/division, division by zero if luckySize is 0
dogCore.sendMoney(owner, reward): external value-transfer call executed in a loop over winners
dogCore.sendMoney(dogCore.cfoAddress(), totalAmount/10): external value-transfer call to cfo
currentCVariation: storage pointer to the round being settled
lottery.getCLottery(): external call returning spoolAmount used in payout math
dogCore.getDog(dogId): external call per dog inside the settlement loop
dogId: dog identifier read from currentCVariation.luckyDogs in the loop
owner: winner address read from currentCVariation.luckyAccounts in the payout loop

edges.reason: Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable
msg.sender is assigned to owner during construction
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership
newOwner parameter overwrites the owner state variable
transferOwnership mutates the privileged owner variable
random() derives entropy from a miner-influenceable keccak256 input
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 randomness (timestamp dependency)
randomSeed is mixed into the keccak256 entropy
keccak256 result is stored in local randomValue
random() updates randomSeed using an unchecked multiplication
randomValue is multiplied by block.number without overflow checks
unchecked product is written back into randomSeed
setVariationProbably writes variationProbably
_value parameter is stored into variationProbably
onlyOwner restricts who may change variationProbably
setVariationCycle writes variationCycle
_value parameter is stored into variationCycle
onlyOwner restricts who may change variationCycle
constructor assigns _dogCore to the dogCore contract reference
_dogCore parameter becomes the dogCore state variable
constructor calls setLotteryAddress to wire the lottery
_lottery is forwarded to setLotteryAddress
variationCycle determines the initial withdrawBlock of the pushed CVariation
constructor pushes the first round into cVariations
onlyOwner restricts the lottery address update
_lottery parameter is stored into the lottery state variable
setLotteryAddress assigns the validated candidate to lottery
createVariation performs an unchecked seed multiplication
_gene multiplies randomSeed without overflow protection
the unchecked product is written back to randomSeed
createVariation calls the internal random() generator
_totalSupply determines totalRandom (or the 20000 floor)
variationRandom is used as the dividend of the modulo check
totalRandom is multiplied by variationProbably inside the modulus argument
variationProbably participates in the unchecked multiplication
createVariation authorizes msg.sender against dogCore and owner
registerVariation authorizes msg.sender against dogCore and owner
_dogId is pushed into the current round's luckyDogs array
_owner is pushed into the current round's luckyAccounts array
callBackVariations binds a storage pointer to the current round
cVariations is indexed to obtain currentCVariation
callBackVariations invokes the external getCLottery query
lottery state variable is the target of the external call
spoolAmount returned by getCLottery feeds the luckyAmount computation
callBackVariations computes the pool share with unchecked math
luckyAmount local holds the unchecked arithmetic result
computed luckyAmount is stored into currentCVariation.totalAmount
callBackVariations derives luckySize from the winner list
luckyDogs length of the round bounds the settlement loops
callBackVariations calls dogCore.getDog for each candidate dog
dogCore is the external contract queried via getDog
luckySize bounds the loop that performs the external getDog calls
index loop variable selects dogs for the external call
dogId read from luckDogs is passed to getDog
callBackVariations computes the per-winner reward with unchecked math
reward local holds the computed payout value
luckySize is used as a divisor, allowing division by zero
settlement loop performs an external value transfer to each winner
dogCore.sendMoney is an external call that transfers funds
the payout amount originates from the computed pool share
winner address from luckyAccounts is the recipient of the external transfer
callBackVariations performs a second external transfer to the cfo
dogCore.sendMoney is invoked again for the cfo address
totalAmount derived from luckyAmount funds the cfo transfer
callBackVariations requires msg.sender to be the coo or the owner
external sendMoney payload can re-enter callBackVariations before state is finalized
winner address is read from the round's luckyAccounts storage array
